title: Generate First Alert voice agent scenario analysis

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Started First Alert voice-agent scenario analysis. Confirmed inputs: 1,974 normalized product rows and BERTopic dependencies are available locally. Running a 50-call structured extraction pilot before the full batch.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Completed First Alert voice-agent scenario analysis. Artifacts are under corpora/first-alert-openai-stt/analysis/voice-agent-scenarios/first-alert-voice-agent-scenarios-v1/. Final stats: 1,974 scenario rows, 84 needs-review rows (4.26%), top reasons are chirping/beeping 513 (25.99%), false alarms 454 (23.0%), and replacement/warranty/refund 317 (16.06%). BERTopic drilldowns and LLM topic labels completed for all calls, smoke-alarm calls, chirping/beeping, false alarms, and replacement/warranty/refund. Final validation passed with no artifact integrity errors.
